whenToUse: There are criteria to compare, such as price or review count.
The default order, such as recommended, has an unclear basis.
whenNotToUse: People must set the order themselves (use a sortable list).
There are only two criteria and a toggle is enough.

alternatives.name: Search Filters
alternatives.reason: Reducing the number of results rather than their order.

accessibility: The button announces the menu with aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.
Items are menuitemradio, with aria-checked on the current order.
Opening it focuses the current order; ↑/↓ move, and Esc returns to the button.
